schedule: cosine per epoch, no warmup, T_max=50

alias_policy.Normal: dataset-qualified N_ICBHI and N_SPR remain independent
alias_policy.Rhonchi/Stridor: Wheeze and Both are observed negative as mutually exclusive native classes; Crackle alias and N_ICBHI remain unknown

selection.monitor: 0.5*ICBHI validation native4 macro multilabel F1@0.5 + 0.5*SPRSound validation native7 macro multilabel F1@0.5
selection.tie: earlier checkpoint retained and no-improvement count increments
selection.target_exclusion: HF, KAUH, ICBHI official test and SPRSound inter excluded

fixed_readouts.sprsound: argmax native scores [N_SPR,Rhonchi,Wheeze,Stridor,CoarseCrackle,FineCrackle,Both], then N_SPR vs adventitious
fixed_readouts.hf: per-window max(Wheeze,Both,Rhonchi,Stridor), then maximum across three fixed 5-s windows
fixed_readouts.kauh: mean B/D/E score vectors [N_ICBHI,Crackle,Wheeze,Both], then argmax and normal/abnormal regrouping
